semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 SharedCalendar retained immutable Calendar owner from sharedcalendar.h. Native deletion releases the adopted JS owner; the UnifiedCache owns the shared wrapper through original hard/soft references. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
